subject: System Design
title: Containers and Kubernetes
description: A quick win: understand Containers and Kubernetes.

hook.text: It works on my machine. With containers, your machine's setup ships alongside your code.

buildup.text: Docker packages an application with its dependencies into an isolated, portable container.

discovery.text: Kubernetes orchestrates containers across a cluster: scheduling, scaling, healing, and networking.

twist.text: Kubernetes is powerful but complex. Running it demands dedicated expertise. Many teams adopt it too early.

climax.text: Containers standardized deployment. Kubernetes standardized orchestration. Together they reshaped infrastructure.

punchline.text: Containers package apps; Kubernetes runs them at scale.

quiz.question: What does Kubernetes do?
options: Orchestrates containers across a cluster for scaling and healing
